title: Actor
description: Who acts or speaks, drawn alike everywhere (doctrine D-062, R6; kete-core spec 149): a person, an agent, Kete, a contact from outside — its name, its face, where a contact came from. A person and a contact are a circle with their initials; an agent and Kete a rounded square with their glyph.

face.description: An agent's face: a glyph and a tint; without it, one is drawn from its id, the same everywhere.
